asciichat_error_t acip_outbound_submitv
  (acip_transport_t * transport, const socket_buffer_t * buffers,
  size_t count, acip_admission_t * admission)


Copy plaintext before returning ACCEPTED; congestion never changes
    encryption state. Handshake/control submissions except ping/pong wait for
    backend submission so crypto/setup barriers hold. Success describes local
    admission/submission, never receiver delivery. A terminal backend failure
    retains its status and errno context for waiting and subsequent producers.
    Congestion remains a nonfatal admission outcome.
